en.headline: Police arrest five in Kwun Tong fishing-machine raid
en.dek: Officers seized four fishing-game machines, game cards and 1,300 dollars in cash from a Shing Yip Street flat in an early-Friday raid.
body: Police arrested five people early on Friday after raiding a flat on Shing Yip Street in Kwun Tong that they said was being used as an illegal gambling establishment.

The Kwun Tong district special duty team and the anti-triad action unit carried out the raid after an investigation, police said. Officers seized four fishing-game machines, a batch of game cards and 1,300 dollars in cash.
Two local men and three local women, aged 30 to 59, were arrested on suspicion of gambling in a gambling establishment. All five were detained for inquiries. Police did not name them.

Under the Gambling Ordinance, gambling in a gambling establishment can bring a fine of up to 30,000 dollars and nine months in jail on conviction. Operating a gambling establishment carries a heavier maximum penalty.

zh.headline: 觀塘成業街搗破釣魚機賭檔 五人被捕
zh.dek: 觀塘警區人員周五凌晨突擊搜查成業街一個單位，檢獲四部釣魚機、一批遊戲卡及1300元現金，兩男三女涉嫌在賭博場所內賭博被捕。
body: 警方周五凌晨在觀塘成業街一個單位採取行動，搗破一個懷疑非法賭檔，並拘捕五人。
警方表示，觀塘警區特別職務隊聯同反三合會行動組經調查後展開突擊搜查，檢獲四部釣魚機、一批遊戲卡及1300元現金。
單位內兩名本地男子及三名本地女子被捕，年齡介乎30至59歲，涉嫌在賭博場所內賭博。五人現正被扣留調查。警方沒有公布他們的姓名。
根據《賭博條例》，在賭博場所內賭博一經定罪，最高可被判罰款3萬元及監禁9個月。經營賭博場所的刑罰則更重。
